title: Suppression of insulin target gene expression by SecinH3 quantified by real-time PCR
protocol: Seed approximately 10^5 HepG2 cells into wells of a 12-well culture plate and incubate overnight.
Wash the cells twice with PBS after the overnight incubation.
Add compounds in desired concentrations (SecinH3, D5, Wortmannin, or DMSO alone) to the serum-starved cells; final concentration of DMSO is 0.2%.
Stimulate cells with 10 nM insulin for 12 hours.
Extract total RNA using Absolutely RNA kit according to manufacturer's instructions; elution volume is 50 μl.
Homogenize 10 mg of liver in lysis buffer and extract RNA using Absolutely RNA kit according to manufacturer’s instructions; elution volume is 50 μl.
Determine the concentration of RNA by photometry.
Use 2.5 μg RNA for reverse transcription with cDNA Archive kit according to manufacturer's instructions; RT volume is 50 μl.
Perform quantitative PCR in a 10 μl scale using gene-specific TaqMan probes according to manufacturer’s protocol.
Normalize all expression levels to the expression level of β-2-microglobulin.
